page_title: NEW 0-2 WHU | Newcastle v West Ham 25/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Craig Pawson is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Newcastle, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+5' Guido Rodriguez (West Ham) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Newcastle have a free kick.
90+2' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the top of the net is far too weak and Lukasz Fabianski makes a simple save.
90+2' Newcastle quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+2' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Newcastle will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+1' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Craig Pawson no option but to blow his whistle.
87' The corner from Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is intercepted by the defence.
86' A quickly taken corner by Newcastle.
84' Here is a change. Crysencio Summerville is going off and Julen Lopetegui gives the last tactical orders to Andrew Irving (West Ham).
84' The game has come to an end for Carlos Soler. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Guido Rodriguez (West Ham).
84' Here comes a substitution. Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is brought on as a substitute for Bruno Guimaraes.
80' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
79' The attendance is 22094.
78' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
78' Newcastle take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
77' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
75' Julen Lopetegui has decided to make a change. Danny Ings (West Ham) replaces Michail Antonio.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) is coming onto the pitch as Emerson cannot continue after picking up an injury.
72' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Newcastle for a penalty. Play continues.
72' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
70' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) serves up a nice cross, but Lukasz Fabianski punches the ball away.
69' Here's the change. Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) leaves the pitch and Jacob Murphy comes on as a substitute.
68' Substitution. Anthony Gordon leaves the pitch and is replaced by Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd).
65' A flowing move ends with a great cross into the centre of the box, which Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) latches onto but sends a wild header well wide of the right post.
63' Carlos Soler (West Ham) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Nick Pope.
61' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lloyd Kelly (Newcastle Utd) was quite harsh and Craig Pawson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
60' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
59' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Nick Pope easily deals with the threat.
59' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
59' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
57' Sean Longstaff comes off the pitch to be replaced by Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd).
57' Jean-Clair Todibo (West Ham) is substituted due to injury. Julen Lopetegui gives a chance to Konstantinos Mavropanos.
55' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Nick Pope as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
53' 0 - 2 Jarrod Bowen plays a neat ball into the path of Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham), who makes room for a shot and sends in a low drive which bounces in off the left post! 0:2.
52' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the left post.
48' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) is in the right place at the right time to receive a rebound and decides to shoot from long range, but his effort is immediately blocked.
48' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
47' West Ham work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
47' Michail Antonio (West Ham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. West Ham force their opponents to concede a corner.
46' Eddie Howe makes a switch. Harvey Barnes is coming on in place of Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' A dangerous attempt from Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) was aimed towards the roof of the net, but Nick Pope pulls off a superb save and stops this one.
45+1' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
45+1' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) whips in a cross from the corner, but Lukasz Fabianski is well positioned and punches the ball away.
40' Bruno Guimaraes tees up Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) with a precision cross. He holds off the defender, but fires his shot just wide of the left post.
39' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
36' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
36' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Lukasz Fabianski.
34' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) dances his way past two defending players and gets to the edge of the box from where he unleashes a shot that goes well wide of the right post.
33' The cross into the penalty area from Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
32' A cross by Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.

29' What a save from Lukasz Fabianski! Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
26' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Craig Pawson saw the whole situation.
26' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
24' The game is interrupted now, Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
23' Carlos Soler (West Ham) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post.
21' Referee Craig Pawson halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Julen Lopetegui, then shows him a yellow.
21' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) is penalised for a foul. Craig Pawson had a clear view and blows his whistle.
18' Lloyd Kelly (Newcastle Utd) misses a complete sitter from the corner, heading the ball well wide of the left post from close in.
18' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) will take the corner.
18' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
17' Newcastle can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
17' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. Newcastle will have a chance to score from a corner.
15' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.
13' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Carlos Soler (West Ham).
12' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Emerson (West Ham).

10' 0 - 1 A perfectly taken corner kick. Tomas Soucek (West Ham) gets on the end of it and produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes inside the right post, increasing the score of today's match – 0:1.
10' The referee signals a corner kick to West Ham.
9' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Michail Antonio (West Ham).
7' Dangerous play by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd). Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) has a goal ruled out for offside!
4' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
2' A sweet pass inside the box gives Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
1' The first half has started.
